findings.problem: 25 chars at a two-digit count against en's 16 ('Mark all 12 read', +56%; the template alone is +21%, 51/42), in the 'narrow section header' the en sidecar calls Short. The shed rule MARK_ALL_READ_LABEL_SHED = "@max-[253px]/chatheading:sr-only" (chat-sidebar.tsx:438) is a fixed px point calibrated on the English length, and the sibling heading is the flexing label (min-w-0 flex-1 truncate) while the action Button is shrink-0 - so in the visible-label band the ru section name ellipsises earlier than in en. The count itself stays visible. Not measured in a rendered frame (host rules: no browser), hence minor not major.
